description: Intel-powered Googlebooks can reportedly run 96.6 percent of the more than 10,000 most-used Android apps. The laptops use a translation layer to run apps designed for Arm processors, converting their code into instructions Intel chips can handle. Google says the system helps demanding apps run smoothly. Most of the apps that do not work have compatibility issues with large-screen devices, while some require hardware such as a gyroscope.
title: Google Reportedly Explains How Intel Googlebooks Run Arm Android Apps

description: Samsung Week 2026 is now live in India with discounts across Samsung’s consumer electronics range. The sale covers Galaxy smartphones, tablets, wearables, laptops, TVs, audio products and monitors, with discounts reaching 60 percent in some categories. Buyers can also get bank discounts, cashback, exchange benefits, loyalty points and EMI options on eligible products. Samsung has also announced extended warranty benefits for select products. The offers are available through Samsung.com, the Samsung Shop App and Samsung Exclusive Stores, with individual benefits varying across categories.
title: Samsung Week 2026 Sale in India Offers Up to 60 Percent Off on Galaxy Phones, Tablets and More

description: Vivo showcased its first mixed reality at an event held in India. Vivo launched the Vision headset in China last year, and we got to try some of its features and take a closer look at the underlying hardware in a quick demo. Here’s what we found out.
title: Vivo Vision Discovery Edition First Impressions

description: Anthropic has launched Claude for Google Workspace in public beta, bringing the AI assistant to Google Docs, Sheets and Slides. The new add-on places Claude alongside an open file and lets users edit text, work with spreadsheet data and create slides. Anthropic has also introduced connectors that let users create or edit Google files from Claude's chat. Users can approve individual changes or allow Claude to apply them automatically. The integration is available to users across all paid Claude plans.
title: Claude for Google Workspace With Docs, Sheets and Slides Support Launched in Beta for Paid Users

description: WhatsApp is reportedly developing a new Contacts tab. The new feature could help users to find people, see who is online, and access additional features. It could include a green indicator showing contacts who are currently online. The feature is currently under development for Android. Contacts tab could also include shortcuts to other WhatsApp features.
title: WhatsApp Could Get a New Contacts Tab With Online Status and Birthday Reminders

description: Cross-border payments firm Conduit Technology has sued Tether over $2.76 million (roughly Rs. 267 crore) in USDT frozen since September 2025. Conduit claims the wallet held its working capital and was not linked to the Brazilian investigation that prompted Tether’s action. The company is seeking access to the funds and at least $2.76 million in damages.
title: Tether Faces Lawsuit From Conduit Over $2.76 Million in Frozen USDT

description: Oppo Find X10 series will launch in India soon. Ahead of it, an alleged live image of the Find X10 series model has leaked online. The leaked image shows the handset running ColorOS 17. The software is based on Android 17 and is also seen on the Find X10 models launched in China. Oppo launched the Find X10, Find X10 E, and Find X10 Pro Max in China last month with a starting price of CNY 5,499 (roughly Rs. 78,000).
title: Oppo Find X10 Series Hands-on Image Surfaces Online Ahead of India Launch

description: Xbox CEO Asha Sharma reportedly told staff at a town hall meeting on Tuesday that Project Helix, the next-generation Xbox, will be a “family of devices”. The executive said that the tenth generation of Xbox consoles will also cater to people “on the go”, suggesting the console family will include gaming handhelds.
title: Next-Generation Xbox Will Be a 'Family of Devices', Says Xbox CEO Asha Sharma
What Snapdragon X2 Plus Brings to the Lenovo Yoga Slim 7x: All-Day Battery, On-Device AI and Quiet Performance

description: Samsung Galaxy F70 5G has appeared on Google's Supported Devices List with the model number SM-E176E and codename a17x. The same codename is associated with the Galaxy A17 5G, suggesting that Samsung could introduce the F70 5G as a rebranded version of the A-series phone. The handset has also reportedly received BIS certification in India. Its specifications have not been revealed, although it could share some hardware with the Galaxy A17 5G. Samsung has yet to announce its launch details.
title: Samsung Galaxy F70 5G Spotted on Google Play Console With Galaxy A17 5G Codename, BIS Database

description: Apple is reportedly planning to widen its smart home lineup through a partnership with LG Electronics. They are said to launch a new smart doorbell, thermostat and smart lock, along with security cameras. These smart home products are likely to work with Apple's upcoming smart home hub. The hub is expected to be unveiled on October 13 and could feature a 6-inch square display. The smart home devices will reportedly come with LG branding. Apple is expected to handle the design and engineering of the devices.
title: Apple Reportedly Teams Up With LG for Smart Doorbell, Thermostat, Security Cameras, and More

description: Bitcoin Group’s Futurum Bank is exploring partnerships with licensed German firms after BaFin rejected its MiCA licence application. The bank had planned to operate Bitcoin.de’s revamped crypto exchange itself, but will now consider using external firms for trading and custody. Bitcoin Group can object to the decision within one month of receiving the formal notification.
title: BaFin Rejects Bitcoin Group SE’s MiCA Application for Futurum Bank After 15-Month Review

description: Google has announced the expansion of Gemini in Chrome in India. As part of the move, the Mountain View-based tech giant is bringing its AI browsing assistant to Android users. Google says Gemini in Chrome can summarise lengthy webpages, answer questions about content, work with Google apps, and generate or edit images using Nano Banana. Apart from this, Auto Browse, which is Google’s agentic feature, is rolling out on both desktop and Android.
title: Gemini in Chrome Gets Auto Browse in India, Letting AI Handle Web Tasks

description: Pudgy Penguins’ parent organisation is shutting down Abstract, its Ethereum Layer 2 network, after investing tens of millions of dollars into the project. The blockchain will stop operating on December 15, with users asked to withdraw their assets beforehand. The decision follows limited liquidity and a choice to focus funding on the Pudgy Penguins brand and PENGU cryptocurrency.
title: Pudgy Penguins’ Abstract Closes, Marking Second Ethereum Layer 2 Shutdown in a Week

description: Sony has launched three new party speakers in India under its second-generation ULT Power Sound range. The ULT Tower 5 and ULT Tower 7 come with built-in batteries and are rated to deliver up to 20 and 30 hours of playback, respectively. The ULT Tower Max is the flagship model with a 2,150W output and three 280mm woofers. All three models offer party-focused features, including karaoke and DJ connectivity, while the Tower Max also gets a 100-LED lighting system.
title: Sony ULT Tower 5, Tower 7 and Tower Max With Up to 2,150W Output Launched in India: Price, Specifications

description: The Xbox Elite Series 3 controller has leaked via Xbox Design Lab. The leak, spotted by a Reddit user, suggests that users will be able to choose between Hall effect and TMR thumbsticks when customising the controller in Xbox Design Lab. The Elite Series 3 controller could also come with advanced haptics, a dedicated audio scroll wheel, and more.
title: Xbox Elite Series 3 Controller Leaks, Revealing New Features and Design Lab Customisation Options

description: Vivo Y32 launched in global markets with an 8,000mAh battery. It runs on an octa-core chipset and has an IP68 and IP69-rated build for dust and water resistance. The Vivo Y32 has a dual rear camera unit, including a 50-megapixel wide-angle primary sensor. The Vivo Y32 features a 6.87-inch HD+ display. It is currently available in Bangladesh and Nepal.
title: Vivo Y32 Launched With 6.87-Inch Display, 8,000mAh Battery: Price, Specifications

description: OpenAI introduced age prediction in ChatGPT earlier this year. The system helps the AI chatbot determine whether an account may belong to someone under the age of 18. The San Francisco-based AI company has now detailed how its age prediction functionality works. As per OpenAI, it adds an extra layer of protection beyond the date of birth provided when an account is created. Instead of only relying on a user’s stated age, it looks at behavioural and account-level signals.
title: OpenAI Reveals Exactly How ChatGPT Predicts Your Age

description: The Redmi 17C 5G is now available for purchase in India, following its launch in the country last week. The handset sports a 6.9-inch display with a 120Hz AdaptiveSync refresh rate. It is powered by the MediaTek Dimensity 6300 chipset, coupled with up to 6GB of RAM. For photography, it gets a 50-megapixel AI camera. The Redmi 17C 5G runs on HyperOS 3 and packs a 6,000mAh battery with 33W fast charging.
title: Redmi 17C 5G With 6,000mAh Battery Goes on Sale in India: Price, Specifications

description: Lenovo ThinkBook 14x has been launched in India with up to an Intel Core Ultra 7 256V chipset. The new ThinkBook laptop features a 14-inch 2.8K OLED display with up to a 120Hz refresh rate. It has 16GB RAM and up to 1TB storage. The Lenovo ThinkBook 14x carries up to a 65Wh battery. The new model has a starting price tag of Rs. Rs. 1,08,990.
title: Lenovo ThinkBook 14x Launched in India With Intel Core Ultra Series 2 Processors: Price, Specifications

description: Xbox has confirmed that Grand Theft Auto 6 will get Cloud Gaming support on Xbox Series S/X. The company said the game will be cloud streamable on its consoles, but not on PC. The clarification came after a report claimed that Microsoft had secured exclusive streaming rights for GTA 6. Grand Theft Auto 6 will launch on PS5 and Xbox Series S/X on November 19.
title: GTA 6 Will Get Xbox Cloud Gaming Support on Xbox Series S/X, but Will Not Stream on PC

description: Airtel announced free international roaming for all postpaid subscribers in India on Wednesday. The move aims to alleviate the expense of international roaming, which has traditionally been an additional cost for mobile users travelling abroad, with operators offering separate packs for data, calls, and SMS. The benefit will extend to every member on eligible Airtel postpaid family plans. The telecom operator said that subscribers will be eligible to avail one international roaming trip per year.
title: Airtel Announces Free International Roaming on All Postpaid Plans With 5GB Data, 60 Minutes Calls

description: 13 Deals Worth Buying Before the Sale Ends
title: Flipkart Big Billion Days 2026 Is Here: These 13 Offers Won’t Last Long

description: The Vivo X Fold 6 has launched in India, and the brand is marketing it as a productivity-focused device for professionals. It comes with a higher price tag than its Android rivals and includes hardware upgrades alongside a refreshed cosmetic design.
title: Vivo X Fold 6 First Impressions

description: Google has announced EmbeddingGemma 2 as its latest open, lightweight multimodal embedding model. It is designed for on-device multimodal embeddings, natively mapping combinations of text, images, audio, and video into a unified embedding space. The  EmbeddingGemma 2 weights are available through Hugging Face and Kaggle. It is built on the Gemma 4 architecture, and the model has 740 million parameters. It is released under an Apache 2.0 commercial license. Google has also launched Nano Banana 2.1 as an update to Nano Banana 2.
title: Google Unveils EmbeddingGemma 2 With Multimodal Search and On-Device AI Support; Nano Banana 2.1 Announced

description: The Wikimedia Foundation says it has identified activity from AI agents it believes were operated by OpenAI across its projects. The reported activity included unauthorised wiki edits, attempts to use Etherpad to retrieve information from other websites and millions of requests to Wikimedia APIs. The Foundation also linked hundreds of thousands of Wikidata Query Service requests to the activity and said they may have contributed to a partial outage in May. Wikimedia found no evidence that its systems or data were compromised.
title: Wikimedia Says Suspected OpenAI AI Agents Generated Millions of Requests, Made Unauthorised Edits: Report

description: Tipster Roland Quandt on Bluesky suggests Microsoft will launch the new Surface Laptop Ultra at its event later today. The company is tipped to launch two RTX Spark-based configurations. He states that pricing will start "from under ~3K to over ~7K for high-end configurations". The tipster claims the Surface Laptop Ultra will be the only new Surface hardware to launch at the event. Microsoft Surface Laptop Ultra is tipped to come in 24GB, 32GB, 48GB, and 64GB RAM options. All models seem to have 1TB SSD storage and Wi-Fi connectivity. They could run on Windows 11 Pro.
title: Microsoft Surface Laptop Ultra Price Details Leaked Ahead of Launch; Specifications Tipped Alongside

description: HMD Slate Tab 5G could be gearing up for a return with a much larger design than previously reported. New renders reportedly show a 15.6-inch LCD panel, colourful finishes and POGO contacts that could support a keyboard or other accessory. Earlier leaks described a 10.6-inch 2K tablet with a Snapdragon 7s Gen 2 chipset, 8GB of RAM and a 9,250mAh battery. The conflicting reports leave the final hardware unclear, while HMD has yet to confirm the tablet or its launch plans.
title: HMD Slate Tab 5G Design Leaks Again, Could Feature Huge 15.6-Inch Display, POGO Pins, and More

description: Facebook is said to be testing a new Reels-first experience in India. According to a report, selected Facebook users are now being taken directly to a full-screen video experience when they open Facebook. The move reportedly aims to change how users interact with the social media platform. The report mentions that the classic Feed, which users traditionally see when the app is opened, will continue to be available as a separate tab. Alternatively, they can reportedly switch back to the Feed-first experience.
title: Facebook Reportedly Testing New Reels-First Experience in India Putting Video Front and Centre

description: Bitcoin is consolidating below recent highs as repeated rejections near $87,000 limit the recovery. Large holders continue to accumulate Bitcoin, while about 40,000 BTC has left Binance in the past two weeks. However, cooling ETF flows, elevated Treasury yields, and monetary-policy uncertainty are keeping traders cautious.
title: Bitcoin Struggles Below $87,000 Despite Rising Whale Accumulation

description: Amazon is all set to kick off its Great Indian Festival sale tomorrow. It is the e-commerce giant’s biggest festive sale event of the year, bringing a range of smartphone deals across price segments. Customers can avail of price cuts, bank discounts, exchange bonus options, and no-cost EMI benefits during the sale. If upgrading to a new smartphone is on your wishlist this festive season, the Great Indian Festival is one of the best avenues to do so. Ahead of the sale, Amazon has revealed several enticing offers on a range of smartphones, including the Galaxy S25 Ultra, iPhone 16, Xiaomi 17, iQOO 15R, and more.
title: Amazon Great Indian Festival Smartphone Deals: Samsung Galaxy S25 Ultra, iPhone 16 Get Big Discounts

description: Sony could be preparing a significant refresh of its PlayStation Portal with an OLED display among the upgrades. Newly surfaced information suggests that the Japanese tech conglomerate is developing two versions of its video game streaming device. Launched in 2023, the PlayStation Portal lets users stream games from a PlayStation 5. While it is not a fully standalone handheld gaming console, an OLED upgrade could move the PlayStation Portal closer to the PlayStation Vita.
title: Sony’s Next PlayStation Portal May Get an OLED Screen, New Listings Suggest
